responsibility: Implements iterator-based manipulation of GENERIC statement lists and compound-expression statement sequences. It manages allocation and recycling of STATEMENT_LIST nodes, appending and forced appending of statements, insertion before/after iterator positions, delinking, and helpers that extract the first, last, or only non-debug expression from nested COMPOUND_EXPR or STATEMENT_LIST structures used during gimplification and generic tree rewriting.
same_name_distinction: Implements statement-list storage and editing operations for GENERIC trees, including STATEMENT_LIST allocation/caching, insertion, delinking, and expr_first/last/single helpers. Unlike gcc/tree-iterator.h, it provides the executable list-manipulation routines behind the iterator API.
